_about: Bed for the Fourier explainer (bin/vh music), 3Blue1Brown register: felt piano over soft strings and a low D drone, no drums. 75 BPM (24 frames a beat at 30 fps), D major. The score starts 0.3 s into the film (tools/build_audio.sh delays it), so beat k is at 0.3 + 0.8 k s: A 0.3–4.3 (5 beats) · C 4.3–8.3 (5; the equation writes from 4.3) · D 8.3–14.7 (4+4, the harmonics) · Dinf 14.7–17.1 (3) · E 17.1–18.7 (2, the zoom) · F 18.7–21.9 (4, the overshoot) · P 21.9–25.1 (4, the payoff). Without drums a chord 0.1–0.2 s off a picture change reads as phrasing; the frame-exact moments are the foley's partial-sum tones, which spell D4's harmonic series (D, A, F#, and a flat C). The piano answers them: A on the 3rd harmonic's merge (10.2), F# on the 5th (12.5), C on the 7th (14.4, a D7 colour that leans into G for the sweep). Hush on E (Dsus2), unresolved Bm7 under the horn, and the D major chord lands with the brace (21.8).
